translations.text: She will go after her lovers but will not catch up with them; she will seek them but will not find them. Then she will say, “I will go back to my first husband, because I was better off then than now.”
Therefore I will take back my grain at its appointed time and my wine at its appointed time. I will take back my wool and my linen, which I gave her to cover her nakedness.

On that day I will make a covenant for them with the wild animals, the birds of the sky, and the creatures that crawl on the earth. I will abolish the bow, the sword, and warfare from the land, and I will let them dwell securely.
Your strength is like that of a bandit. The priests banded together on the road and committed murder at Shechem, for they did evil.
They turned to nothing and became like a treacherous bow. Their leaders will fall by the sword because of the insolence of their tongues. This will bring them ridicule in the land of Egypt.
For it is from Israel, and a craftsman made it; it is not God. Rather, your calf, Samaria, has become a source of idolatry.
I wrote for him the many teachings of my law, but he regarded my words as something foreign.
Israel forgot his Maker and built temples, and Judah multiplied fortified cities. I will send fire into his cities, and it will consume their fortifications.
I will not unleash my fierce anger, nor will I turn again to destroy Ephraim, because I am God and not a human being. I am the Holy One among you, and I will not enter the city.
They will come trembling like a bird from Egypt and like a dove from the land of Assyria. I will return them to their dwelling places, says the Lord.
Canaan holds deceitful scales in his hand, and he loves to oppress.
Ephraim will say, “What more have I to do with idols?” I have humbled him, and I will make him glorious like a luxuriant fir tree. From me your fruit is found.
